L376@P10: 7. PRECAUTIONS FOR USING LITHIUM ION RECHARGEABLE CELL
L377@P10: The precautions described below are important to assure the performance and safety of
L378@P10: designed pack. Mishandling may cause cell leakage, heat, smoke, explosion or fire. Please
L379@P10: follow instructions carefully.
L380@P10: 7.1 Intended Use
L381@P10: E-bike, E-scooter, power/garden tools, marine, drone/UAV, household, energy storage
L382@P10: & Medium power application.
L383@P10: The cell is prohibited to use in e-cigarette, vaporizers (e-cig, vape, mod) or any other
L384@P10: similar devices applications.
L385@P10: 7.2 Handling Precautions
L386@P10: 7.2.1 Charging
L387@P10: The lithium ion rechargeable cell is to be charged by “constant
L388@P10: current/constant voltage” method. The lithium ion cell is charged at a constant
L389@P10: current (CC Mode) until the cell voltage reaches a specific voltage, followed by
L390@P10: a constant voltage charge (CV Mode) at the specific voltage. The charging
L391@P10: current at this constant voltage tapers off. As long as the tapering current is
L392@P10: down to a particular current, the charge process is deemed complete.
L393@P10: 1) Charge voltage:
L394@P10: Do not exceed the specified charge voltage (4.2V per single cell). If the
L395@P10: cells are used in battery packs, the maximum voltage is 4.2 x N (N=
L396@P10: number of cells connected in series) V.
L397@P10: 2) Charge current:
L398@P10: Charge the cell at the specified charge current listed in section 4.10 or
L399@P10: less.
L400@P10: 3) Charge temperature:
L401@P10: Charge the cell at the temperature range of 0C ~ 60C. Due
L402@P10: consideration should also be given to the arrangement of the battery pack
L403@P10: so that it is in that temperature range even though it is effected by heat
L404@P10: generated from the cell charger. The cell surface temperature must not
L405@P10: exceed 70°C.
L406@P10: 7.2.2 Reverse charging:
L407@P10: The cell must be prevented from reverse-polarity charging.
L408@P10: 7.2.3 Discharging
L409@P10: A lithium ion rechargeable cell starts to discharge at 4.2V and terminates at a
L410@P10: cut off voltage of 2.5V.
L411@P10: 1) Discharge current:
L412@P10-11: Discharge the cell at the specified discharge current listed in section 4.10Document
L413@P11: Name Cell Specifications of INR-21700-M65A
L414@P11: Document
L415@P11: No. INR21700M65A -01 Ver. 0.1 Page 11 of 15

L417@P11: Proprietary of E-One Moli Energy Corp.
L418@P11: or less. In case a peak current of higher than maximum discharge current
L419@P11: depending on the pulse interval may reduce the cell capacity.
L420@P11: 2) Discharge temperature:
L421@P11: Discharge the cell at temperature range from –30C to 60C. At a
L422@P11: temperature of –30C or less, the cell will show a significant decrease in
L423@P11: discharge capacity. The cell surface temperature must not exceed 80°C.
L424@P11: Recommended thermal cut-off of 80°C at high rates.
L425@P11: 3) Discharge termination voltage/Over discharge:
L426@P11: Avoid discharge to voltage less than 2.5V per single cell. A leakage
L427@P11: current to the equipment may over discharge the cell, which may damage
L428@P11: the performance of cell.
L429@P11: 7.2.4 Long-term Storage
L430@P11: 1) In case of long-term storage, store the cell at <23C, low humidity,
L431@P11: noncorrosive gas atmosphere.
L432@P11: 2) The cell voltage should be maintained at greater than 2.5V. Should the cell
L433@P11: voltage approach to 2.5V (0% SOC) it is recommended that the cell be
L434@P11: charged back up to 30% capacity.
L435@P11: 3) Do not store cell in humid environment.
L436@P11: 4) Long-term Storage may cause loss of capacity recovery.
L437@P11: 7.3 Safety Precautions
L438@P11: 7.3.1 When using the cell
L439@P11: WARNING
L440@P11: 1) Mishandling of a cell can lead to generation of heat, possible explosion or
L441@P11: ignition and potential serious injury. Safe handling guidelines include the
L442@P11: following:
L443@P11: (1) Do not expose cell to fire or heat.
L444@P11: (2) Do not install the cell backwards.
L445@P11: (3) Do not expose the cell to water or salt water, or allow the cell to get
L446@P11: wet.
L447@P11: (4) Do not carry or store the cells together with necklaces, hairpins or
L448@P11: other metal objects.
L449@P11: (5) Do not place the cells in microwave ovens, high-pressure containers,
L450@P11: or on induction cookware.
L451@P11: (6) Do not connect the positive terminal and the negative terminal of the
L452@P11-12: cell to each other with any metal objects such as chains, coins or Document

L459@P12: (7) Do not pierce the cell with nails, strike the cell with a hammer, step
L460@P12: on the cell, or otherwise subject it to strong impacts or shocks.
L461@P12: 2) Do not disassemble or modify the cell. The cell contains safety and
